title: code-projects Simple Content Management System Admin welcome.php authorization
desc: A vulnerability was detected in code-projects Simple Content Management System 1.0. Impacted is an unknown function of the file /web/admin/welcome.php of the component Admin Interface. The manipulation of the argument addnews results in missing authorization. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used.

title: FLTK through 1.4.5 Heap Buffer Overflow via Fl_BMP_Image Integer Overflow
desc: FLTK through 1.4.5 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in Fl_BMP_Image::load_bmp_() that causes undersized pixel buffer allocation from file-supplied width and height. Attackers can supply a crafted BMP or ICO file with large dimensions so row decoding writes file-derived data past the heap buffer, corrupting the application heap.

title: libfvde through 20260923 Heap Out-of-Bounds Read via libfvde_encrypted_metadata_read_type_0x0024
desc: libfvde through 20260923 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in libfvde_encrypted_metadata_read_type_0x0024() because xml_plist_data_size is not checked against the source metadata block. Attackers can supply a crafted FileVault 2 Core Storage volume that makes libfvde_volume_open() copy past the heap block buffer, crashing the application.

title: libdwarf through 2.3.3 Heap Out-of-Bounds Read via dwarf_debug_addr_table
desc: libdwarf through 2.3.3 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dwarf_debug_addr_table() that omits the table starting offset when validating .debug_addr unit length. Attackers can supply a crafted object file with a non-zero offset table, causing dwarf_debug_addr_by_index() to read past the heap buffer, disclosing adjacent heap bytes or crashing consumers.

title: libpff through 20260926 Heap Out-of-Bounds Read via libpff_table_read_values_array
desc: Libpff through 20260926 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in libpff_table_read_values_array because a 7c column definition's values_array_size is not checked against remaining buffer bytes. Attackers can supply a crafted PST, OST or PAB file to make applications read adjacent heap memory into record entry values or crash.

title: libcss through 0.9.2 NULL Pointer Dereference via Media-Query Parser
desc: libcss through 0.9.2 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in mq_parse_media_query() that allows remote attackers to crash consumers by supplying media lists ending in a comma. Attackers can serve a stylesheet whose @media or @import media list has a trailing comma, causing NetSurf or other parsers to crash.

title: ntop nDPI through 6.0 Out-of-Bounds Read in SoftEther Dissector
desc: ntop nDPI through 6.0 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dissect_softether_host_fqdn() in softether.c that compares host_name using the consumed byte count instead of data length. Remote attackers can send crafted short UDP datagrams on already-classified SoftEther flows, causing strncmp to read beyond the packet payload buffer.

title: Transmission 4.0.0 before 4.1.3 Permissive CORS Leaks RPC Anti-CSRF Token
desc: Transmission 4.0.0 before 4.1.3 contains a permissive CORS vulnerability in handle_request() in rpc-server.cc that exposes the X-Transmission-Session-Id anti-CSRF token to any web origin. Malicious web pages can read the token from the 409 handshake response and replay it to issue RPC calls, enabling script-torrent-done execution, download-dir changes, or torrent and data deletion.

title: DOMPurify before 3.4.17 DOM XSS via IN_PLACE Hook-Detached Subtrees
desc: DOMPurify before 3.4.17 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to keep event handlers armed when an IN_PLACE hook removes a parent or sibling node. Attacker markup in detached subtrees is never walked or neutralized, so handlers like img onerror fire after sanitize() returns, causing DOM XSS.

title: OpenPanel before 3.0.0 ClickHouse SQL Injection via event.events tRPC Query
desc: OpenPanel before 3.0.0 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to bypass tenant scoping by injecting unescaped profile filter names into a JOIN subquery. Attackers can supply a crafted filter name with a trailing comment to bypass the project_id WHERE clause and read events from all projects.

title: OpenPanel before 3.0.0 Sandbox Escape RCE via Webhook JavaScript Template
desc: OpenPanel before 3.0.0 contains a sandbox escape vulnerability in the js-runtime validator that allows a project member to bypass the AST allowlist by aliasing the Function constructor. Attackers with write access can read payload.constructor.constructor into a local and call it to run arbitrary code in the worker process.

title: OpenPanel before 3.0.0 Improper ClickHouse Escaping in sankey.service.ts
desc: OpenPanel before 3.0.0 contains an improper escaping vulnerability in sankey.service.ts that allows authenticated project members to break ClickHouse string literals by supplying backslashes in event names. Attackers with read access can submit crafted events[].name values to the chart.sankey procedure, causing ClickHouse parse errors that disable the project's Sankey chart endpoint.

title: llama.cpp b5899 before b10261 Heap Out-of-Bounds Write via plamo2 Tokenizer
desc: llama.cpp b5899 before b10261 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in llm_tokenizer_plamo2::build that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory via crafted GGUF models. Attackers can supply BYTE-typed token text like <0x-1> whose negative parsed value writes token ids before the bytes_ buffer during model loading, causing crashes or potential code execution.

title: YesWiki from 4.6.0 before 4.7.0 SQL Query Disclosure via showreq Parameter
desc: YesWiki from 4.6.0 before 4.7.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to view assembled SQL queries by adding the showreq parameter. Attackers can append showreq to public Bazar listing API requests to obtain table names, JSON storage paths, ACL filter logic, and collation, aiding targeted SQL injection.

title: YesWiki before 4.7.0 Stored XSS via Referer Header in referrers_sites Handler
desc: YesWiki before 4.7.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in handlers/page/referrers_sites.php that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts via crafted Referer headers. Attackers can send a Referer hostname containing HTML metacharacters that renders unescaped, executing JavaScript for any referrer-sites page visitor to perform same-origin authenticated actions.

title: YesWiki before 4.7.0 SQL Injection via despam.php INTERVAL operand
desc: YesWiki before 4.7.0 contains a sql injection vulnerability in despam.php where the from parameter is escaped but placed in an unquoted INTERVAL position. Authenticated administrators can inject SQL via the from POST parameter to perform blind reads of the database including user password hashes.

title: DevilutionX 1.4.0 through 1.5.5 Heap Buffer Overflow via libmpq__archive_dup
desc: DevilutionX 1.4.0 through 1.5.5 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in the bundled libmpq libmpq__archive_dup routine when opening crafted MPQ archives. Attackers can supply an MPQ archive whose block table count exceeds its hash table count, causing memcpy to overflow the heap during startup and crash the game.

title: Semantic MediaWiki 3.0.0 before 7.3.1 Denial of Service via Special:Search Compact Filters
desc: Semantic MediaWiki from 3.0.0 before 7.3.1 contains an algorithmic complexity vulnerability in TermParser::normalize_compact_form() that allows unauthenticated attackers to cause quadratic CPU consumption. Attackers can submit long search terms with many distinct in:(...) or has:(...) expressions to Special:Search to exhaust PHP search workers when the extended search engine is enabled.

title: Semantic MediaWiki 2.5.0 before 7.3.1 Missing Authorization via Is edit protected
desc: Semantic MediaWiki from 2.5.0 before 7.3.1 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows ordinary editors to permanently protect pages by adding an Is edit protected annotation. When $smwgEditProtectionRight is enabled, EditProtectionUpdater applies indefinite edit and move restrictions without checking the author's rights, locking other editors and administrators out.

title: Semantic MediaWiki 3.0.0 before 7.3.1 CSRF via Special:SMWAdmin Maintenance Actions
desc: Semantic MediaWiki from 3.0.0 before 7.3.1 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in Special:SMWAdmin because it overwrites the wpEditToken with a freshly generated valid token. Attackers can lure an authenticated smw-admin user to a malicious page that triggers schema setup, entity-disposal, or job actions, causing semantic data loss and resource exhaustion.

desc: SemanticMediaWiki from 5.0.0 before 7.3.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in ext.smw.tooltip.tippy.js that renders data-* attributes via innerHTML with allowHTML enabled. Editors can plant a .smw-highlighter span with a malicious data-content, data-title, data-top, data-bottom, or data-theme attribute to execute JavaScript when viewers, including administrators, hover it.

desc: REDAXO before 5.21.4 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows content editors to inject HTML by storing unescaped values rendered by media, medialist, link and linklist widgets.
